graph.title: LEGO BrickHeadz 41488 Master Wu
notes: Piece count: 79 individually numbered parts (b1-b79) plus 2 arm copies x3 parts and 2 foot copies x2 parts = 89, matching the parts list.
Ids b1-b79 follow build order, skipping pieces that belong to the two repeated sub-assemblies (step 8 arm and step 23 foot).

Step pictures do not show which exact studs or bricks are used, so ports are left null. Which specific gray brick a plate or tile attaches to (steps 3-6, 9-13, 16-20) is my best reading of the pictures. The pieces and the stacking order are certain, but the exact neighbour is approximate.
The arm sub-assembly (step 8) is joined to the white 4x4 plate b19 through its 2x2 plate. This is approximate, because the picture shows it sliding onto the plate's side.
The staff bar b77 is held by the clip of arm copy 1, the viewer's left hand. It is shown held in the clip but never fitted as a separate step.

The step 22 plate with opening (b69) is attached to the underside of b2 after turning the model over. The feet (tan plates) then fit into b69's underside, and the brown plates stand on the base plate b79.

The hat stack (6x6 dish, tan round plate and conical hat) is built on the 8x8 dish, which is then pressed onto the head top. I joined it to round plate b36 only; the macaroni tiles have no ports in the catalogue.
